titleEn: Paths in Matrix Whose Sum Is Divisible by K
title: 矩阵中和能被 K 整除的路径
summary: 从左上到右下只向右或下移动，统计路径元素和能被 k 整除的路径数并取模。
insight: dp[r][c][remainder] 记录到该格路径和余数的方案数，从上方和左方状态加上当前值后转移新余数。
pitfalls: 只需保存模 k 余数

solutions.title: 网格余数 DP
solutions.idea: 把路径和压缩成 k 种余数状态。

code.java: class Solution { public int numberOfPaths(int[][] grid,int k){int mod=1_000_000_007,rows=grid.length,columns=grid[0].length;int[][][] dp=new int[rows][columns][k];dp[0][0][grid[0][0]%k]=1;for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<columns;c++)for(int remainder=0;remainder<k;remainder++){int ways=dp[r][c][remainder];if(r+1<rows){int next=(remainder+grid[r+1][c])%k;dp[r+1][c][next]=(dp[r+1][c][next]+ways)%mod;}if(c+1<columns){int next=(remainder+grid[r][c+1])%k;dp[r][c+1][next]=(dp[r][c+1][next]+ways)%mod;}}return dp[rows-1][columns-1][0];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numberOfPaths(grid:Array<IntArray>,k:Int):Int{val mod=1_000_000_007;val rows=grid.size;val columns=grid[0].size;val dp=Array(rows){Array(columns){IntArray(k)}};dp[0][0][grid[0][0]%k]=1;for(r in 0 until rows)for(c in 0 until columns)for(remainder in 0 until k){val ways=dp[r][c][remainder];if(r+1<rows){val next=(remainder+grid[r+1][c])%k;dp[r+1][c][next]=(dp[r+1][c][next]+ways)%mod};if(c+1<columns){val next=(remainder+grid[r][c+1])%k;dp[r][c+1][next]=(dp[r][c+1][next]+ways)%mod}};return dp[rows-1][columns-1][0]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int numberOfPaths(vector<vector<int>>& grid,int k){const int mod=1000000007;int rows=grid.size(),columns=grid[0].size();vector dp(rows,vector(columns,vector<int>(k)));dp[0][0][grid[0][0]%k]=1;for(int r=0;r<rows;++r)for(int c=0;c<columns;++c)for(int remainder=0;remainder<k;++remainder){int ways=dp[r][c][remainder];if(r+1<rows){int next=(remainder+grid[r+1][c])%k;dp[r+1][c][next]=(dp[r+1][c][next]+ways)%mod;}if(c+1<columns){int next=(remainder+grid[r][c+1])%k;dp[r][c+1][next]=(dp[r][c+1][next]+ways)%mod;}}return dp.back().back()[0];} };
